title: tilia pseudorubra
intro: Tilia pseudorubra, commonly known as Small-leaved Lime, is a deciduous tree species native to Eastern Europe and Asia. Its leaves and flowers have been used in traditional medicine, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Tilia pseudorubra include sedative and calming effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress relief and promoting a restful sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
